children: MongoDB reported second quarter fiscal 2027 total revenue of $771.8 million, up 30% year‑over‑year, with GAAP net income of $40.9 million ($0.50 diluted) and non‑GAAP net income of $162.6 million ($1.90 fully diluted). The company delivered a GAAP gross profit of $569.8 million (74% margin) and non‑GAAP gross profit of $585.7 million (76% margin), while non‑GAAP operating margin rose to 24%. Management raised full‑year fiscal 2027 guidance, citing strength in Atlas, Enterprise Advanced and AI-related momentum.
Total revenue: $771.8 million for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, up 30% year‑over‑year.
Gross profit: GAAP gross profit $569.8 million (74% gross margin); non‑GAAP gross profit $585.7 million (76% non‑GAAP gross margin).
Income from operations: GAAP income from operations $28.4 million; non‑GAAP income from operations $185.9 million (24% non‑GAAP operating margin).
Net income: GAAP net income $40.9 million, or $0.50 per diluted share; non‑GAAP net income $162.6 million, or $1.90 per fully diluted share.
Cash flow and liquidity: Free cash flow $137.6 million for the quarter; cash, cash equivalents and short‑term investments totaled $2.4 billion as of July 31, 2026.
Atlas momentum: Atlas revenue grew approximately 29% year‑over‑year in the quarter and remains the largest subscription product category.
Enterprise Advanced and other: EA & other revenue grew approximately 36% year‑over‑year, reflecting strength in self‑managed and private/hybrid deployments.

Product and AI initiatives: General availability of MongoDB Search and Vector Search in Enterprise Advanced; new Atlas capabilities for AI retrieval including Automated Embeddings, Embedding and Reranking API, voyage‑code‑4, and Vector Search in Atlas Stream Processing.

Developer and ecosystem engagement: Launched Atlas Managed MCP Server to connect coding agents to live Atlas data; announced plan to upskill two million Indian builders by 2030 and expand MongoDB for Academia in India.

Customer and backlog trends: Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) reached $1,519.2 million, up 91% year‑over‑year; current RPO $797.3 million, up 73% year‑over‑year; total customers exceeded 70,600 and Atlas customers exceeded 69,300 as of July 31, 2026.
